about.title: Hi, I'm Vera
about.body: A wedding decorator, florist and mum from Zalakaros. Decorating my own wedding showed me this is what I can do with heart and soul – since then I've helped dozens of couples make their big day unforgettable.

cta.title: Like what you see?
cta.body: Tell me about your wedding – the venue, the date, your ideas – and I'll put together a detailed quote for you.

hero.title: Wedding decoration, floristry, prop rental
hero.intro: There are three ways I can help: I take over the whole decoration, I create the floral pieces, or I lend you the props if you'd like to decorate yourselves. Each service can be booked on its own.

full.title: Full-service wedding decoration
full.intro: If you'd rather not handle the wedding decoration yourselves, choose my full-service package. It covers everything from planning through floristry to styling the venue and taking it all down the next day. The perfect choice if you dream of a stress-free morning on your big day.
full.scope: You can ask for the decoration of the civil ceremony site, the floral styling of the church ceremony and the festive dressing of the reception venue. Don't need all three? No problem – each part can be booked separately.

meeting.title: No-obligation first meeting
meeting.body: At our first meeting you can tell me all about your ideas – and if you don't have any yet, that's fine, we'll shape the concept together. I'll suggest ways to make the decoration special or where you can save. Feel free to bring pictures that capture the mood you're after.

quote.title: Detailed quote
quote.body: Based on what we discussed, I prepare a detailed quote. My existing props are provided for a rental fee; single-use items (candles, napkins, custom signs) fall into the purchase category. I don't charge labour separately – it's included in the item prices. The last line is travel, quoted per kilometre.

visit.title: Free venue visit
visit.body: We visit the wedding venue together – and I don't charge mileage for it. It's a vital part of planning: we decide what goes where, I take measurements (for the head-table backdrop, for example), we ask the staff what's allowed, and we get a feel for which decoration suits the venue's atmosphere.

floral.title: Creating the floral pieces
floral.body: I create the floral decoration from seasonal, freshly delivered flowers sourced from local growers and wholesalers. I aim to bring as many special varieties as possible into the design – it makes your wedding all the more unique.

full.checklistTitle: Which floral pieces does a wedding usually need?

checklist.boutonniere: boutonnières for the groom and the men
checklist.church: altar, gallery and pew decoration in the church
checklist.installations: installations behind the head table, at the civil ceremony site, at the photo spot
checklist.hair: floral accessories for the bride: crown, flower comb

floristry.title: Wedding floristry with seasonal flowers
floristry.intro: Romantic, colourful, fragrant floral pieces from the seasonal flowers in bloom right now – in a natural palette, tailored to the venue and to you.
floristry.body: I source the flowers from local growers and wholesalers right before the big day, so they go into bouquets and arrangements fresh and long-lasting. If you'd like to decorate yourselves, I'm still happy to make your bouquets and floral pieces – floristry can be booked on its own.
floristry.season: The choice is richest from April to October: tulips, daffodils, ranunculus and anemones in spring, peonies, larkspur and snapdragons in summer, dahlias, zinnias and asters in autumn. We'll find a solution outside the season too – let's talk it through at our first meeting.

rental.title: Prop rental
rental.intro: Want to decorate your wedding yourselves without investing a lot in props or worrying about where to store them afterwards? I can help with that too.
rental.body: Wedding arches, a light curtain, vases, tea lights, candle holders, crates, planters, a red carpet and other decoration pieces are available. Let's go through what you might need!

cta.title: Let's talk about your wedding
cta.body: The first meeting is free of obligation – tell me about your ideas and I'll show you how we can bring them to life.

wooden-arch.name: Wooden wedding arch
wooden-arch.description: Our wooden arch suits the civil ceremony and also works as a backdrop behind the head table. It can be decorated in many ways.
wooden-arch.notes: Comes in five parts; two people assemble it in about 15 minutes, the parts are fixed with screws.

birch-arch.name: Birch wedding arch
birch-arch.description: Our birch-wood arch works at the civil ceremony as well as at the reception venue. Decorate it any way you like.
birch-arch.notes: Comes apart into three pieces, assembled with screws – a 10-minute job for two people.

gold-flower-stands.name: Gold flower stands
gold-flower-stands.description: Our metal flower stands suit round tables best but look great on long tables too. Any floral piece can go on top: fresh, dried or artificial.

cylinder-vase-set.name: Cylinder vase set
cylinder-vase-set.description: Our three-piece glass cylinder set is a perfect table centrepiece and works as an accent almost anywhere. For candlelight, use floating candles.
cylinder-vase-set.notes: Please don't light pillar candles inside: the wax runs into the vase and can't be cleaned out – in that case the vases have to be purchased. Sizes: 28×8 cm, 23×10 cm, 17×12 cm (height × diameter).

gold-candle-holder-set.name: Gold metal candle holder set
gold-candle-holder-set.description: If you want truly exclusive footed candle holders in your decoration, this set won't disappoint. Slim design, for taper candles, ideal for round and long tables alike.
gold-candle-holder-set.notes: Comes apart into three pieces for easy transport. Heights: 23, 28 and 33 cm; inner diameter 2.2 cm.

champagne-wall.name: Champagne wall
champagne-wall.description: A spectacular piece – the perfect prop for the champagne reception, and usable all evening if kept topped up.
champagne-wall.notes: Comes with an illuminated “Cheers” sign. Holds 100 glasses in total (90 with the sign in place). Easy to assemble.

wedding-mirror.name: Lettered wedding mirror
wedding-mirror.description: Lift your decoration with a lettered mirror – as a welcome sign, a seating chart or a sweet message to your guests. The rental includes the design and application of the custom decal – after you get in touch, we send you a mock-up.
wedding-mirror.notes: The rental covers one weekend: collect from Thursday, return by Monday evening. Please agree a date with us before ordering. The deposit is refunded when the mirror is returned undamaged.

cta.title: Would you like to reserve something?
cta.body: Send an email with the items you've chosen and your wedding date, or call and we'll go through the details.

about.intro: I'm Veronika Sebőkné Antalics – wedding decorator, florist and mum.
about.story1: The idea of working as a wedding decorator came to me while I was creating the decoration for my own wedding. I loved the months of planning and the styling before the day – I was completely on fire. The world of weddings and creating with flowers has always drawn me in. This is what I can truly do with heart and soul.
about.story2: A wedding is a special, deeply meaningful day in everyone's life. Every girl secretly dreams of feeling like a princess on her big day and saying “I do” surrounded by loved ones in beautifully decorated surroundings.
about.story3: That's what I'm here for: to lift the whole weight of the decoration off your shoulders – from the preparations through the setup to the take-down the next day. My work helps make your wedding a lasting memory you'll love looking back on in the photos. Let the decoration of your big day be unforgettable!

garden.title: My garden – taking a break
garden.body: For several seasons I grew the cut flowers for my weddings in my own garden – it shaped the natural, seasonal style that is still my signature today. Because of the increasingly dry summers the garden is resting for now, but as soon as the weather allows I'll return to it. Until then I work with fresh, seasonal flowers from local growers and wholesalers.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice summarises what data the fiorevera.hu website processes, why and for how long. Controller: Veronika Sebőkné Antalics (Fiore Vera), 8749 Zalakaros, Rózsa utca 53., Hungary.

form.title: Contact form
form.body: The details you enter in the form (name, email address, optionally phone number, wedding date, venue, message) are used solely to answer your enquiry and prepare a quote. The form service forwards the data to info.fiorevera@gmail.com, where I keep it in my mailbox no longer than the validity of the quote, or until the end of our contractual relationship if you book. The legal basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

storage.title: Language preference
storage.body: If you dismiss the language suggestion or switch languages, we remember this in your browser's local storage (localStorage) so you don't have to choose again. This information never leaves your device and can be removed at any time by clearing your browser data.

analytics.title: Visitor statistics
analytics.body: The site uses Vercel Web Analytics, a cookie-free, anonymous visitor measurement. It stores no personal data and does not track you across other websites – which is why this site has no cookie banner.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access to, correction or deletion of the data stored about you and withdraw your consent at any time via info.fiorevera@gmail.com. You may lodge a complaint with the Hungarian data protection authority (NAIH) or your local supervisory authority.

testimonials.borbely-antalics-csilla: Absolutely professional! We received work that met every one of our expectations. Fair value for money. We can only recommend her.
testimonials.toth-szabo-klaudia: One of the defining moments of our wedding for me was when we walked into the restaurant where the reception was held and I saw the decoration. What Vera created exceeded all my imagination – it was simply beautiful.
